programme.title: Отважные
programme.desc: Сериал рассказывает о работе специального подразделения полиции, занимающегося проблемами домашнего насилия. Четыре главные героини помогают женщинам, детям и даже мужчинам, страдающим от тирании, побоев, унижений и других способов угнетения со стороны близких людей. Героини сериала будут попадать в сложные и опасные ситуации, спасая жизни и восстанавливая справедливость. Каждая женщина из этой четверки тоже прошла через насилие: у каждой – своя история, скелет в шкафу и сильная мотивация заниматься именно этим делом.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I simply cannot wait for more!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it. In this series of 20 films, of 26 minutes each, the habitat will be a major showcase revealing our capacity to adapt ourselves at a time where we need to find solutions in order to address immense changes.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ - experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Follow breathtaking travel adventures of some well known athletes of extreme sports. Have a look at some stunning locations in Alaska, Mexico, Argentina, Japan, Tahiti, Africa, Costa Rica, Norway, Hawaii and whitewater kayaking, extreme big mountain skiing, windsurfing, kiteboarding, extreme snowboarding and big wave surfing that push the limits of possibility. The focus is on compelling personalities and great storytelling.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Fishing Prince Rupert, Ha-Nee-Nah Lodge on Dundas Island and Hecate Strait for Chinook Salmon and Pacific Halibut!

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We visit Canada's capital city on a hill in Ottawa, Ontario. We'll sail down the famous Rideau Canal locks. We go deep into Ottawa's cold war history at the Diefenbunker, as well as, explore Canada's military history at the Canadian War Museum. Then we head up the Peace Tower and take a look at the library of Parliament. Finally, we learn about Canada's first nation's tribes at the Canadian History Museum.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Travel Thru History (or TTH for short) is a new educational/informational (E/I) series designed to spark interest and enthusiasm in viewers to learn about our country's rich and fascinating history by traveling to diverse locales across the US. While it is targeted to a teen audience, the entire family will enjoy watching TTH. Videotaped and edited in the style of other popular, educational programming like Modern Marvels, Travel Thru History is the latest television series co-developed by The Television Syndication Company and Red 5 Creative.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: For 15 years the Big Coast Crew has remained completely committed to expedition boating, showcasing West Coast adventure and telling the tales of this final frontier. From iconic Chinook salmon to Grizzlies, Spirit Bear and Orcas, incredible wildlife roams this land and keeps watch over one of the last great coastal ecosystems on Earth. Each season, Big Coast runs the BC Inside Passage from Alaska and Prince Rupert Southbound through Great Bear Rainforest and Vancouver Island. It's an epic journey of 1,500 kilometres through pristine coastal waterways and wilderness. And each season, with marine weather, wildlife and fish migrations, is a little bit different. In the spirit of coastal conservation, Big Coast practices catch-and-release Tyee Chinook Salmon (over 30lbs) angling and only taking what you need. Going strong for 15 years, Big Coast features 13 new half hour episodes every year! A 300-mile boat trip from Vancouver to Duncanby Lodge in Rivers Inlet for Percy Walkus Hatchery Chinook Fundraiser!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world - something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: With classic tales as The Jungle Book to his credit, Rudyard Kipling brought India to life for many readers around the world. In this episode, Bill steps back into Kipling's wild world while exploring Kanha and Bandhavgarh National Parks, the inspiration for The Jungle Book and many other tales. There, we track tigers and search for jackal, sambar, chital, monkeys and wild boar. We round out the episode with jeep safaris, elephant rides and dinners around the fire.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Journeys in India is a ground-breaking travel series focusing on the Indian subcontinent. This first season highlights the history, culture, architecture, and wildlife of one of the most mysterious and exciting areas on earth. Perfect for the would-be or armchair traveler, this 13 part series is beautifully filmed with all original footage. Join host Bill Ball as he takes you on the adventures of a lifetime!

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: The name alone conjures up mysterious and exotic images. The architecture and backstory to this once powerful independent kingdom, is both amazing and horrifying. Outside the city, Zanzibar earns its "Spice Island" nickname due to the huge plantations that grow everything to make your cooking flavorful. Journeys final stop is to visit the highly endangered Red Colobus monkeys. Learn why these human-like primates eat dirt for survival.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: In this first of a two-parter on the Mara, we follow the migration in anticipation of the famous river crossings. We find all three big cats and hyena waiting for their chance to get their share of the migrants. During migration, the animal numbers are staggering.

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Did you know the potato chip was invented out of anger? Or that "Sweet 'N Low" was named after a song? Or the real truth of why we say "God Bless You" after a sneeze? These questions and more are answered and explained in a new series called "Wow, I Never Knew That!" from Executive Producer Whoopi Goldberg, Tom Leonardis and the Emmy award- winning production company David Harris Katz Entertainment, Inc. "Wow I Never Knew That!" is a whimsical, half-hour television series that is jam-packed with exciting tidbits and fascinating facts that uncover the truths and origins behind the stuff you're already familiar with. From the items you use every day to the phrases you use in conversation to the habits you're so accustomed to, you'll be fascinated to learn how they've all really come about!

programme.desc: Did you know the potato chip was invented out of anger? Or that "Sweet 'N Low" was named after a song? Or the real truth of why we say "God Bless You" after a sneeze? These questions and more are answered and explained in a new series called "Wow, I Never Knew That!" from Executive Producer Whoopi Goldberg, Tom Leonardis and the Emmy award- winning production company David Harris Katz Entertainment, Inc. "Wow I Never Knew That!" is a whimsical, half-hour television series that is jam-packed with exciting tidbits and fascinating facts that uncover the truths and origins behind the stuff you're already familiar with. From the items you use every day to the phrases you use in conversation to the habits you're so accustomed to, you'll be fascinated to learn how they've all really come about!

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: In contrast with popular belief, Edison did not invent the light bulb. Many people contributed to the invention. Mind you, the first lamp was invented around 70,000 BC. Once upon a time we had limelight, which was actually quite unsafe, and then there were arc "arc lamps" - shedding light that blinded movie stars up to the point where they had to wear sunglasses. What Edison did was improve the light bulb to become a practical, affordable and safe product. He tested over 5000 filaments to make the bulb last: from bamboo fiber to a hair out of an assistant's beard. At the same time others were working on light bulbs made with gasses, which we now know as energy efficient lamps. Modern-day lighting innovations are quite startling, a lot of them - we can't even see with the naked eye… Lasers, for example. For the longest time it was merely a pet-theory of the grand Einstein. Nobody knew what to make of this idea that "atoms could release their excess energy as light" When the laser was invented, people joked that the laser was 'a solution looking for a problem'. Now it is omnipresent. In the near future: laser-light therapy by flashing the human brain.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Forests are crucial for our survival on Earth. They absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and supply all living forms with clean oxygen. "We are like a patient in a hospital bed that is turning down their oxygen tank and thinking they could live with a little bit less oxygen and meanwhile the CO2 is increasing in the room" says journalist Andrew Nikiforuk.

programme.title: Сирота казанская
programme.desc: Грабители врываются в квартиру, где проходит девичник пяти преуспевающих подруг. Пять молодых женщин устроили девичник. Они давно не виделись и сейчас им всё интересно — кто чего добился, у кого какой жених, какие сапоги, какие бриллианты… Но неожиданно в квартиру врываются грабители! Девушки уже готовы были отдать им все свои дорогие украшения, однако дело приняло неожиданный оборот…

programme.title: Гудбай, Америка
programme.desc: Виктор Сергеевич едет в Америку в гости к дочери и с ужасом обнаруживает, что его внук Пол хоть и говорит по-русски, но не понимает простых вещей, знакомых и понятных каждому мальчишке в России. Неунывающий Армен пытается закрепиться в США, постепенно постигая все прелести фиктивного брака. Для давно обосновавшейся в Штатах Юли неожиданной проблемой становится невозможность найти правильно приготовленную гефилте фиш. Не так давно переехавший в Америку Игорь всячески старается откреститься от своего русского прошлого, называя себя Джейсоном. Казалось бы, совершенно разные люди с совершенно непохожими проблемами, но способный решить любую проблему авантюрист Григорий доказывает, что это не так. Все герои страдают от одного недуга - пытаются забыть о своих корнях, упуская нехитрую истину: можно уехать из России, но нельзя перестать быть русским.

programme.title: Выстрел в пустоту
programme.desc: Когда Манни только попал за решётку, он не был плохим человеком, однако мир, в котором он оказался, не делит людей на плохих и хороших. В нём существуют только хищники и жертвы, а единственное право, которое там уважают - это право сильного. Манни предстоит решить, как вести себя в этм аду и кем он видит себя в нём - простым грешником, сосланным за свои проступки, или дьяволом, который вселяет страх?

programme.title: За двумя зайцами
programme.desc: Жил-был молодой бездельник по фамилии Голохвастый. Он держал в Киеве цирюльню, пребывающую в плачевном состоянии, но большую часть времени проводил в кутежах и карточных играх. Проигравшись по крупному, Голохвастый решил поправить дела женитьбой…

programme.title: Парень с нашего кладбища
programme.desc: Двадцатипятилетний провинциальный парень Коля приезжает в Москву к своему дяде. Ему нужно как можно быстрее отдать долг, который висит на нем с прошлого места работы, он готов работать каждый день. Точнее, каждую ночь. Так как дядя устраивает племянника ночным сторожем на... кладбище. Новый сторож приступает к первому дежурству, но к тому, что происходит на кладбище, когда стемнеет, он оказывается не готов. А впереди еще не одна ночь, и Коле нужно сделать выбор: разобраться с таинственными гостями или сбежать.

programme.title: Голод
programme.desc: Фильм рассказывает о борьбе заключённых из Ирландской республиканской армии за признание за собой статуса политических. Сначала они пытаются добиться этого, отказываясь мыться, носить тюремную одежду и всячески разводя грязь в своих камерах. Однако эта тактика не принесла плодов: узников насильно стригли и мыли, избивая при этом до полусмерти. Наконец, один из них — Бобби Сэндс — решает начать смертельную голодовку…

programme.title: Свингеры
programme.desc: Богатый предприниматель предлагает своей девушке, успешной топ-модели, способ выхода на более высокие сексуальные отношения. Жена врача, у которого уже просто нет никаких сил на секс, пытается вернуть страсть в их скучную семейную жизнь. В канун Нового года этих, совсем не подходящих друг другу, партнёров сводит вместе приложение для свингеров... Праздничная зимняя ночь возможно станет самой незабываемой для этой компании. И кому-то на голову может свалится даже девушка его мечты...

programme.title: Ниша
programme.desc: Слава бросает грузоперевозки и непонимающую его жену ради мечты стать экстрасенсом-биолокатором. Неудача за неудачей доводят его до разочарования в своем даре — и тогда сотворяет он ненароком чудо: из пустоты появляется моль. Жалкого насекомого оказывается достаточно, чтобы со Славой захотело познакомиться опасное тайное общество.

programme.title: Скиф
programme.desc: Смена цивилизаций пришла в славянские земли. Уходят в прошлое целые народы, достоянием былого становятся и легендарные воинственные скифы. Забыто презрение к роскоши, отринуты гордость и родовые обычаи: свободные кочевники превратились в жестоких наемников, которые служат тем, кто больше заплатит. В это смутное время распри и междоусобицы между людьми обостряются с новой силой. Втянуло в водоворот интриг и разногласий и ратника Лютобора - ему предстоит пуститься в опасный путь, чтобы спасти своих близких. Но в одиночку пробираться через территории враждующих племен очень рискованно, поэтому проводником Лютобору станет пленный скиф Куница...

programme.title: Маленькая Вера
programme.desc: Социальная драма о столкновении разных поколений и слоёв, которое привело к трагедии. Обычная портовая девчонка Вера шатается по городу в сомнительной компании, наведывается на танцплощадку, где городская молодёжь упорно, "стенка на стенку" выясняет отношения под вой милицейских сирен и лай овчарок. Так бы, наверное, все и продолжалось до утомительной бесконечности, если бы не случайная встреча. Полюбив красавца-студента, Вера привела его в дом, назвала мужем и разом преобразилась в заботливую, любящую женщину. И всё было бы хорошо, если бы не отец Веры — обычный советский работяга, который воспринял модного зятя в штыки…

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: Joel Reynolds is the owner and founder of Reynolds Extract, a flavoring-extracts company. Although his business is successful, his marriage lacks passion. He is also often accosted by his annoying neighbor, Nathan. One day, a series of mishaps occur at the extract factory, resulting in an employee, Step, losing a testicle. Cindy, a con artist, reads a news story about the accident. Hatching a get-rich-quick scheme, she gets a temporary job at the factory, manipulating Joel into giving her more information about Step. She also begins a series of petty thefts from her co-workers, who openly accuse each other of the thefts. Although Step initially decides not to sue the company, he changes his mind after a meeting with Cindy, that she sets up in order to meet and flirt with him. Under Cindy's influence, Step hires attorney Joe Adler.

programme.title: Operation Chromite
programme.desc: In 1950, just a few months after North Korean forces have overrun most of South Korea, an American-led United Nations Command is deployed to Korea to aid the struggling South Koreans. General Douglas MacArthur devises a secret plan to attack behind enemy lines at the port city of Incheon. The risky strategy is opposed by leaders of the other military branches, forcing MacArthur to devise a clandestine operation to gather essential information from within occupied Incheon by coordinating a weeklong South Korean intelligence operation known as "X-Ray".

programme.title: Wake
programme.desc: When things get tough for offbeat Carys Reitman, she does what any emotionally isolated, modern girl would do - she goes to strangers' funerals. At one fateful funeral, she unexpectedly meets Tyler, a man mourning his fiancée. Despite the warnings of her undertaker best friend Shane and her roommate Lila, she finds herself connecting to someone for the first time. Searching for answers, Carys goes to see her estranged mother to confront her past. And as she tries to open herself to the risks of love with Tyler, she realizes she may have more to fear than just a broken heart.

programme.title: Saving Lincoln
programme.desc: Director Salvador Litvak and his writing partner, Nina Davidovich Litvak, based their screenplay on their extensive research into Lincoln's friendship with Lamon. ''Saving Lincoln'' charts their relationship from their initial meeting to Lincoln's Presidency. Lamon was a tall, boisterous Southerner who liked to drink whiskey, tell jokes and stories, play the banjo, and wrestle. Despite some pronounced differences between the two men, they shared a fondness for telling jokes and stories, and both felt slavery should be eliminated. Lamon often served as Lincoln's private confidant.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Mayor Cupcake
programme.desc: A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. With no formal experience or education to speak of, she must rely on her street smarts to clean up the town.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets.

programme.title: Decembers
programme.desc: The ghost of a photojournalist killed during the American invasion of Panama in December 1989 returns exactly ten years later to resolve family conflicts.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: Cookies Fortune
programme.desc: Cookie's Fortune unfolds over an eventful Easter weekend in the small town of Holly Springs, Mississippi. The town residents are peaceful, kind folk--with the exception of Camille Dixon (Glenn Close) - a pushy theatre director with an incredibly shy younger sister, Cora (Julianne Moore), whose estranged daughter Emma (Liv Tyler) has just returned to town. On the heels of her latest play, Camille is shocked to discover that her Aunt Jewel Mae "Cookie" Orcutt (Patricia Neal) has committed suicide. Terrified at the thought of how this will tarnish the family name, she eats the suicide note to make it look like a burglary. This set-up leads the police to one main suspect, Willis Richland (Charles S. Dutton), who also happens to be Cookie's best friend. Although the rest of the town is convinced Willis didn't commit the crime, an outside investigator (Courtney B. Vance) isn't so sure. As Easter Sunday and opening night of the play arrive, the truth comes out, revealing more secrets than anyone could have possibly imagined.

programme.title: Crown Vic
programme.desc: A night patrol in L.A. with veteran officer Ray Mandel and ambitious rookie Nick Holland takes an unexpected turn. In order to control the gangs fighting them they'll need much more than the Crown Victoria police cruiser.

programme.title: Love Is Not Enough
programme.desc: Samir, must face his parent's breakup. While they meet to find the way to tell him, the little Samir surprises them, because he knows perfectly what's happening, putting his own parents into a hard place with his vision of the situation.

programme.title: Castle Falls
programme.desc: Action movie. After years of neglect, a building-landmark will be demolished with dynamite. What a few people know is that inside it hides the cash a gang leader stole from his rivals. Will the interested parties reach the treasure in time?

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: Bernie Lootz (William H. Macy) is a long-time "cooler" at the Shangri-La casino in Las Vegas: he is paid to bring his black cloud to any table where a gambler is on a roll. But when Bernie's luck starts changing for the better--thanks in part to a pretty cocktail waitress--he suddenly loses his cooling talents, incurring the ire of the casino owner in the process.

programme.title: John Wick
programme.desc: John Wick on endine palgamõrvar. Kurjategijate jõuk peksab Johni vaeseomaks, röövib ta muskelauto Boss Mustangi ja tapab ta varalahkunud abikaasale kuulunud koerakutsika. Sellest hetkest saab John Wickist maailma kõige ohtlikum mees, kellelt on kõik võetud ja kellel pole enam midagi kaotada... Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Aviaator — valguses ja varjus
programme.desc: R: Martin Scorsese. O: Leonardo DiCaprio, Cate Blanchett, Kate Beckinsale, Alec Baldwin, Jude Law jt. Draama. Hollywoodi ühe legendaarsema režissööri Martin Scorsese mastaapne film USA lennundusisa Howard Hughesi (Leonardo DiCaprio) elust ajavahemikul 1920-1940, mil see jonnakas, julge ja ettearvamatu miljardär lavastas ja produtseeris Hollywoodis filme ning testis piloodina oma uut õhusõidukit. Hughesi käe all valmisid mitmed aegumatud linatööd. "Aviaatoris" näeme lähemalt, kuidas ta maadleb eepilise sõjafilmi "Hell's Angels" (1930) tegemisega. Selle filmi õhulahingud pidid tulema ennenägematud, ent tootmisel näis kõik olevat Hughesi vastu ning kulud kasvasid üha pöörasemalt. Viimaks kroonis tegijaid aga siiski edu. Nõnda Hughes elaski, kehastades omal kombel justkui Ameerika ideaali - unistas võimatuna näivast ning ka teostas need unistused, vajadusel eluga riskides ja edu ning hiilguse eest oma närvidega makstes. Scorsese on teinud filmi ajast (ja Ameerikast), mil kõik oli veel justkui alguses ja kõik näis võimalik. Vastuoluline ja karismaatiline Howard Hughes on sellise igakülgselt "kõrge lennu" kehastaja - tuntakse teda ju ka suhete pärast Hollywoodi näitlejate Katharine Hepburni (Cate Blanchett) ja Ava Gardneriga (Kate Beckinsale). Kui Scorsese varasemates töödes oli režissööri ihunäitlejaks Robert De Niro ("Taksojuht", 1976, "Raevunud härg", 1980 jt), siis 2000ndatel võttis selle koha üle Leonardo DiCaprio ("New Yorgi jõugud", 2002). "Aviaator" on Scorsese ja DiCaprio teine ühine töö. Üksteist Oscari nominatsiooni, võit tuli neist viies kategoorias.

programme.title: Segamini paisatud
programme.desc: Romantiline komöödia. Väikelinna ajakirjanik Hannah (Rebecca Hall, "Vicky Cristina Barcelona") jääb noorelt leseks, kui tema tunnustatud folklauljast mees sureb. Naise üksildane elu muutub aga täielikult, kui linna saabub New Yorgist pärit teravmeelne kirjanik Andrew (Jason Sudeikis, "Vastikud ülemused"), kelle eesmärgiks on Hannah' kadunud mehest raamatu kirjutamine.

programme.title: Yves Saint Laurent
programme.desc: Pariis, 1957. Pärast Christian Diori ootamatut surma kutsutakse tuntud moemaja juhtima vaid 21-aastane Yves Saint Laurent. Oma esimese menuka moeetenduse ajal kohtub noormees Pierre Bergega, kellest saab pikkadeks aastateks tema elu- ja töökaaslane ning ühiselt asutatakse mõne aja pärast Yves Saint Laurent'i omanimeline moemaja.

programme.title: Mäluauk

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Ограбление по-женски
programme.desc: Грабить банки – совсем не женское дело. Но если жизнь заставит, то наши женщины справятся и с этим. Нина, Тома и Света – закадычные подруги. Судьба их не слишком баловала. Нина одна растит сына и работает уборщицей в банке. Тома – учительница, вечно влюбляющаяся не в тех мужчин. Света – медицинский работник среднего звена, вынужденная делить с бывшим супругом скромную жилплощадь. Все, что накоплено на черный день, подруги хранят в том самом банке, где работает Нина. Однажды Нина случайно узнает, что все деньги вкладчиков украдены, и чтобы замести следы – планируется инсценировка ограбления. Возмущенные подруги решают проникнуть в хранилище банка и забрать свои вклады. И это им удалось! Но теперь у них "на хвосте" и полиция, и бандиты, чьи деньги они случайно прихватили с собой…

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: The documentary film "Sisters" tells the story of humanity, compassion, and the power of support that help Ukrainians overcome the pain of loss during war. The film shows the stories of women who, having experienced their own tragedy, turned their pain into a good deed. Twin sisters from Dnipro launched a volunteer project "Search with Love and Hope" to care for the graves of Ukrainian soldiers whose families cannot come to the burial sites. The film is not only a story of loss, but also of deep solidarity and gratitude. It reminds us that even in the most difficult times, Ukrainians stick together, support each other, and honor those who gave their lives for freedom.

programme.title: Confined within Russia
programme.desc: This special investigative magazine episode offers a comprehensive analysis of the internal socio-political landscape inside modern Russia. The program uncovers the hidden friction between central authority and the vast, ethnically diverse regions that remain under strict federal oversight. Through exclusive interviews, historical context, and expert commentary, the episode sheds light on human rights challenges, cultural suppression, and the complex reality of life within these borders. A gripping look at power dynamics and systemic control.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: In December of 2017, The New York Times published a stunning front-page exposé about the Pentagon's mysterious UFO program, the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP). Featuring an interview with a former military intelligence official and Special Agent In-Charge, Luis Elizondo, who confirmed the existence of the hidden government program, the controversial story was the focus of worldwide attention. Previously run by Elizondo, AATIP was created to research and investigate Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) including numerous videos of reported encounters, three of which were released to a shocked public in 2017. Elizondo resigned after expressing to the government that these UAPs could pose a major threat to our national security and not enough was being done to deal with them or address our potential vulnerabilities. Now, as a part of HISTORY's groundbreaking new six-part, one-hour limited series UNIDENTIFIED: INSIDE AMERICA'S UFO INVESTIGATION, Elizondo is speaking out for the first time with Tom DeLonge, co-founder and President of To The Stars Academy of Arts & Science and Chris Mellon, former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense and Intelligence, to expose a series of startling encounters and embark on fascinating new investigations that will urge the public to ask questions and look for answers. The series will reveal newly authenticated evidence and footage, interviews from eyewitnesses and former military personnel who have never spoken out before, and extensive breakthroughs in understanding the technology behind these unknown phenomena in our skies.

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: The team's access to UFO evidence is unparalleled and their expertise allows them to quickly identify bogus claims of UFOs. Together, they use eyewitness accounts, scientific experimentation, documents recently released through the Freedom of Information Act and footage that has never been seen before on television to piece together compelling — and at times chilling — evidence of UFO phenomena. Join UFO Hunters Bill Birnes, Pat Uskert, Dr. Ted Acworth, and Jeff Tomlinson as they separate fact from fallacy.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: In the search for life beyond our planet, this documentary investigates areas on earth that are said to have had UFO activity, conspiracy theories and phenomenons. Interviewing a variety of scientists and experts on UFOs and examining when possible evidence can prove or suggest anything towards super natural life. From going off of tales that have been told and spread through generations and or cultures to personal experiences where sighting have occurred the series covers the super natural phenomenon that is life beyond earth.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: The team investigates an alarming pattern of UFOS allegedly appearing near US. Air Force bases that house nuclear weapons, and nuclear-powered US warships. A new eyewitness account suggests these craft have an incredible ability. Connections to a historic sighting where a UFO allegedly interfered with a U.S. nuclear weapon are explored. Elizondo briefs former U.S. Senator Harry Reid who offers a stunning theory about UFOS.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: In 2013, former Canadian Minister of Defense, Paul Hellyer, made a shocking claim--that there is a federation of extraterrestrial beings monitoring and guiding humanity. But why would such an esteemed politician make such a controversial announcement? Ancient Astronaut theorists believe evidence can be found throughout history to prove his claims are true. Stories of emperors, kings and pharaohs consulting a pantheon of nine gods can be found in virtually every culture across the globe.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: Clash of the Gods
programme.desc: Documentary series that in each episode explains the heroic and tragic life of various figures from Greek and Norse mythologies - the most powerful monsters, heroes and Gods, including Thor, Hercules, Beowulf, Minotaur, Odysseus and Zeus. Was ancient Greece's greatest hero Hercules a real person? What inspired the Minotaur's labyrinth? Did Odysseus's famous journey really happen? This series will answer these and many other questions, and experts will connect the myths we all know to actual historical events, and link the stories to mythologies of other cultures as well.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: На своем месте
programme.desc: Инга, Даша и Лариса дружат уже много лет. Инга — домохозяйка и мать троих детей. Даша работала стюардессой, но после развода с мужем уволилась и подрабатывает репетитором английского. Лариса — следователь, и сейчас она после долгого перерыва наконец возвращается на любимую работу. Муж Инги Артём, владелец небольшой фирмы, занимающейся грузоперевозками, заключает \"выгодный\" контракт на перевозку некоего груза. Он не знает, что его друг и бизнес-партнёр Рубен за его спиной договорился с заказчиком — криминальным авторитетом — угнать грузовик фирмы вместе с грузом. А вскоре Инга попадает в ловушку: в багажнике своей машины она обнаруживает труп. Героиня решает провести собственное расследование и привлекает к этому делу подруг.

Муж Инги Артём, владелец небольшой фирмы, занимающейся грузоперевозками, заключает \"выгодный\" контракт на перевозку некоего груза. Он не знает, что его друг и бизнес-партнёр Рубен за его спиной договорился с заказчиком — криминальным авторитетом — угнать грузовик фирмы вместе с грузом. А вскоре Инга попадает в ловушку: в багажнике своей машины она обнаруживает труп. Героиня решает провести собственное расследование и привлекает к этому делу подруг.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Третья жизнь Дарьи Кирилловны
programme.desc: Как многие провинциалы, Даша сама пробивалась в Москве и за несколько лет встала у руля модного архитектурного агентства. Столичная жизнь превратила скромную Дашу в Дарью Кирилловну, и даже муж побаивается ее буйного нрава. Но в один миг судьба героини круто меняется. После страшного нападения Даша приходит в себя в чужом городе и не может вспомнить ничего о своей прошлой жизни…

programme.desc: Как многие провинциалы, Даша сама пробивалась в Москве и за несколько лет встала у руля модного архитектурного агентства. programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Северное сияние. Ведьмины куклы
programme.desc: Известная писательница Агата Север и ее помощница Маруся возвращаются на остров, чтобы разгадать семейный секрет. Поездка превращается в настоящий кошмар. Тетя Агаты погибает при загадочных обстоятельствах, а вскоре писательница становится подозреваемой в убийстве своей двоюродной сестры. Чтобы снять с себя обвинение, Агате предстоит пролить свет на тайны прошлого и раскрыть преступление, случившееся на острове много лет назад.

programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Анатомия убийства
programme.desc: Евгения и Сергей расстались, но она осталась работать патологоанатомом в местной полиции по приглашению следователя Перфильева. Сергей Карский получил возможность наслаждаться славой. После публикации его романа, который он написал не без участия Евгении, но что-то в их отношениях сломалось. Его друг, встретившись с Женей по работе, был крайне удивлён таким течением событий. Прекрасный специалист в своём деле Евгения продолжает раскрывать запутанные преступления, и Карский всегда готов оказаться рядом с ней во время поисков разгадок. Перфильев внимательнейшим образом относится ко всем предположениям талантливой коллеги...

programme.title: CNN Newsroom
programme.desc: CNN Newroom provides the most up to date news as it breaks and is the longest running show on the channel, airing twice a day Monday to Friday and throughout the day over the weekends. CNN has developed a lot since its founding in 1980 by American media proprietor Ted Turner as a 24 hour cable news channel. As an organisation, CNN have won multiple awards, including a network-record six news & documentary Emmy Awards in 2018.

programme.title: The Whole Story with Anderson Cooper
programme.desc: Magazino. Current affairs show.

programme.title: Fareed Zakaria GPS
programme.desc: Weekly public affairs show hosted by an American journalist, political scientist, and author Fareed Zakaria. The show is broadcasted on CNN every Sunday in many countries of the world. The "GPS" in the show's title stands for "Global Public Square," a reference to the show's focus on international issues and foreign affairs. The guests of the show's one-on-one interviews and roundtable discussions are most prominent figures in the world of global politics, economy and global decision-makers and influencers.

programme.title: African Voices
programme.desc: Shining a spotlight on Africa's most influential and inspiring talents through in-depth, authentic conversations. Hosted by Larry Madowo.

programme.title: Marketplace Middle East
programme.desc: Business show revolves around cutting edge economic trends and latest business developments in the Middle East. The focus is on the key cities of the region, its most important sectors and industries. The guests of the show are significant representatives of the business community in the region.

programme.title: Marketplace Africa
programme.desc: Unique access to the latest African market information, with a look at events and developments that impact its business world. Follow the business stories that influence the African continent. Eleni Giokos is a CNN correspondent based in the network's Johannesburg bureau and the show's host. Every week she interviews figures of business and industry to reveal the economic trends in various regions of Africa and to present the continent's key sectors and corporations.

programme.title: Quest's World of Wonder
programme.desc: Join our host, Richard Quest, as he takes us on a journey of discovery to some of the most iconic cities on the planet. Richard encounters many of the influential local inhabitants and delves into the heritage and culture of each city to reveal what makes them unique and fascinating. The first series sees Richard travel around the globe to visit Washington D.C. and explore the awesome power that resides in the city; in Panama City, Richard searchess for some of the legendary figures who shaped its identity; the vibrancy of Nairobi excites the imagination while Athens treis to sustain its legacy in the modern world; multi-cultural London reveals its elegant and martial history and the people of Berlin enahnce its attractions; and the exotic and singular atmosphere of Istanbul delights the senses.

programme.title: Inside Africa
programme.desc: Each week, Inside Africa documentary series on CNN highlights the unique diversity of mysterious Africa, its numerous cultures and religions, peoples, art, music, cuisine, travel and literature, its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna. Watch the interviews with people from various spheres of life and find out more surprising facts about this continent: how it fights for conservation of rare animals, who the new figures in fashion and design are, what the new educational programs for children look like. Everything what Africa is filled with and lives for is in this series.

Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons' search for a parking space at the mall takes a little longer than expected. When the Wattersons arrive at the mall for a day of shopping, they struggle to find a space in the parking lot. They search for a space everywhere -- using all their intelligence, cunning and trickery -- but as the day goes on, the desperate hunt for a space becomes more important than the trip to the mall itself.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin see an advert for the latest, cutting-edge Bobert operating system and excitedly talk Bobert into downloading it. At first it seems like a massive improvement, but the many flaws in the new operating system become increasingly apparent. After the upgraded Bobert malfunctions one too many times, the kids decide to reinstall his old operating system. But will they be able to downgrade from the upgrade and get their old friend back?

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The kids try to help Dad bond with Frankie. / When the uncomfortableness between them reaches new levels Gumball and Hot Dog Guy decide they have to confront their ongoing awkwardness by making things as awkward as possible. / The kids realise that they've never known their neighbour's name, and they're way past the window where they can ask. / Gumball has something uncomfortable to tell Penny but doesn't know how, until he makes a deal with Principal Brown. / Gumball and Anais go head to head in a leadership election voted for by their classmates. / Clayton realises he can imitate his classmates, and begins stealing the lives of the people of Elmore. / When unexpected couples in the world of Elmore start randomly falling in love, Gumball and Darwin have to figure out what's going on. / Gumball questions Mr Small's eco-friendly commitment, causing him to abandon society and live in the forest. Director: Mic Graves.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Adventure Time

They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: Off the Grid
programme.desc: This exciting series takes you to some of the most unusual places all around the world. programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: For many years passion for travelling has been bringing people to unexplored continents, countries and places to look into culture, history, food, nature and people. programme.title: Xplore Philippines
programme.desc: Join Indian movie star Elisha Kriis as she travels the archipelagic Philippines, uncovering the world of paradise this picturesque country has to offer. Compromising 7,641 islands, the Philippines boasts some of our planet's most idyllic beaches and blissful blue waters that draw in millions of tourists every year. With a population of over 104 million people, presenter Elisha Kriis reveals the history behind this former Spanish colony and what makes it uniquely different to its Southeast Asian neighbours. From the bustling Manilla to the calming Bohol, this stunning documentary series explores never-before-seen areas.

Nicknamed the "teardrop of India" this paradisaical island gem is home to some of our planet's most fascinating wildlife.

programme.desc: Närvide kosutus maalilisel põhjarannikul on kujunenud hoopis pingeliseks detektiivitööks. Mõrvu üha lisandub ja juhtum muutub aina keerulisemaks. Ka Gerth ja Kaspar löövad kaasa. Lisaks muretseb Frida oma eksmehe tervise pärast, keda ta ometi maapõhja neab.

programme.title: Kerge elu
programme.desc: Toomas ja tema naine Stella elavad koos oma kahe teismelise lapsega pealtnäha unistuste elu. Keegi ei või arvatagi, et pereisal on minevikust kahe miljoni suurune käendusvõlg ja et seda peret hoitakse üleval ainult kuritegevusega. Kui aga Toomasele tuleb pakkumine osaleda suures raharöövis, ei aima veel keegi, kui halvasti asjad minema hakkavad. Osades Margus Prangel, Helena Merzin, Mirjam Aimla ja Siim Sups. Režissöör Raoul Suvi, stsenarist Mikko Pölla.

programme.title: Lõks
programme.desc: Tütar leiab oma isa läbilõigatud kõriga kodust voodist. Tuba on seestpoolt suletud ning asi tundub väga üheselt räigel moel ellu viidud enesetapule. Mõned mõrvarühmast, aga on skeptilised taolise lahenduse osas ning jätkavad uurimist. Alex külastab vanglas kedagi, keda ta ei tohiks, selleks et selgust saada politseinike omavahelistest teemadest. Asi hakkab võtma kuriteo mõõtmed ning lõhnab arreteerimiste järgi. Uurimine on ummikus, ning enesetapu versioon tundub peale jäävat. Mõrvapaigal ringi nuuskides avastavad uurijad midagi hämmastavat, mis juhatab ka juhtunu põhjuste jälile. Episood lõpeb tõepoolest arreteerimisega, aga sellisega, mis on välguks selgest taevast kõigile.

programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. programme.title: 11 000 aastat hiljem
programme.desc: Veel enne, kui Eestisse jõudsid ristirüütlid, olid siin külakogukonnad ja kihelkonnad, mis moodustusid külade nõndaöelda kihlumisel. Tõenäoliselt oli kihelkondi muinasaegses Eestis 45. Pärast vallutusi jäi niisugune jaotus püsima, selleks ajaks oli kihelkonnakeskustesse juba kirikud rajatud...

programme.title: Pilvede all
programme.desc: "Pilvede all" on draamasari kolmest õest. See on ühe põlvkonna lugu - see on Pireti, Mari ja Kertu lugu, kuid see võib olla ka Sinu lugu.

programme.title: Televisiooni lapsed
programme.desc: ETV arhiivi põhjal valminud meelelahutuslik saade. Režissöör Jaan Laugamõts, toimetaja Reet Oja.

programme.title: Lemmikute lemmik
programme.desc: Lemmikloomasaade toob ekraanile toredad ja õpetlikud loomalood. Teeme tutvust veterinaaria tänapäevaste võimalustega ning anname sõna loomaspetsialistidele.

programme.title: Üksildane Uitaja ja Don Quijote Tallinnas
programme.desc: Kui Rasmus Kangropool oli Tallinna muinsuskaitse juht, tahtis ta kogu südamest, et vanalinn säilitaks oma näo targalt planeeritud keskaegse linnana. Sama asja pärast käisid ka Uitajad linnas ringi ja toppisid oma nina "kitsastesse kohtadesse".

programme.title: Õhtu tantsuga
programme.desc: Tunneme rõõmu muusikast ja tantsimisest. Saatejuht Ants Tael.

programme.title: Ekskursioon
programme.desc: "Ekskursiooni" saatejuhi Anu Saagimi ekraanipartner on ekspoliitik Heimar Lenk.

programme.title: Teledoktor Viktor Vassiljev
programme.desc: Aastakümneid televaatajate tervise eest hoolitsenud kuulus teledoktor Viktor Vassiljev on nüüd KORDUSSAATENA ekraanil. Stuudiosse EI SAA HELISTADA.

programme.title: Eestlane ja venelane
programme.desc: See on seltskond, kes topib oma nina igaühe probleemidesse ja kui probleemi ei ole, siis oskab ta selle hoobilt tekitada...

programme.title: Nädalalõpp Kanal 2ga
programme.desc: Mõnus meelelahutusaates räägivad põnevad külalised lõbusaid lugusid, tehakse muusikat ja viiakse läbi üllatavaid eksperimente. Saadet juhivad Teet Margna ja Kristjan Jõekalda.

programme.title: Suur komöödiaõhtu
programme.desc: Tuntud näitlejad naerutavad vaatajat lõbusate sketšide, vaimukate paroodiate, ootamatute ülesannete, pööraste libauudiste ja muusikaliste viguritega.

programme.title: Saare sosinad
programme.desc: Põnev kodumaine sari "Saare sosinad", kus seltskond eestlasi püüavad sotti saada aastakümneid tagasi toimunust ja seda kõike päikeselisel Madeira saarel, kuhu justkui tellimise peale lisandub aina salapärasemaid tegelasi.

programme.title: Kelgukoerad
programme.desc: Telesari kriminaaluurijatest, kel tuleb lahendada kõige keerulisemad juhtumid ja tabada ohlikud kurjategijad.

programme.title: Elmar TV
programme.desc: Raadiost Elmar tuttav Eesti muusika kullafond ja ka värsked kodumaised hitid hoiavad Eesti Kanalis öösiti tuju üleval. Nostalgitse või laula kaasa, kodumaiste muusikavideote paremik on eetris!

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Vägivaldne jõuk ründab ravimeid transportivaid veokeid ja varastab ravimeid, kuid nende motiiv on keerulisem kui lihtsalt raha. Juhtum paneb Uptoni ja Ruzeki suhte proovile.

programme.title: Hudson ja Rex
programme.desc: Ellujäämissaate otseülekandes saab inimene karurünnakus surma. Uurijad avastavad aga, et tegu oli mõrvaga. Tiim seab tapja tabamiseks lõksu üles.

programme.title: Rängad kuriteod
programme.desc: Raske isiksusehäirega laps läheb kaduma ja tiim peab juhtumi lahendama enne, kui on juba hilja. Jack Raydor püüab heastada aastaid, kui ta hooliv lapsevanem polnud.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Adrian Monk on üks San Francisco politseijaoskonna parimaid töötajaid, kuid pärast abikaasa traagilist surma on kõik muutunud: andekast detektiivist sai üleöö ettearvamatu ja impulsiivne inimene, kellel on ebanormaalsed hirmud ja kes ärritub väga kergesti. Sellest hoolimata püüab Monk oma tööd edasi teha, kuid sellel on ettearvamatud tagajärjed.

programme.title: Elu
programme.desc: Lugu kahest kurjategijast, kes avastavad elu tõelise väärtuse pärast eluaegse vanglakaristuse väljakuulutamist.

programme.title: Õnnetooja Chuck
programme.desc: Charlie Loganil lasub juba koolipõlvest alates needus. Nüüdseks edukaks hambaarstiks saanud mees ei ole võimeline leidma tõelist armastust. Veelgi hullem, ühe endise pruudi pulmas saab ta teada, et viimne kui tüdruk, kes temaga maganud on, leidis kohe järgmisel kohtamisel oma elu õnne. Enne kui ta arugi saab, on Chucki kui "õnnetooja" maine levinud kulutulena ning teda piiravad lugematud õnneotsijad - seksikatest võõrastest kuni tema ülekaalulise sekretärini.

programme.title: Tuhat sõna
programme.desc: USA 2012 komöödia Lavastaja: Brian Robbins Osades: Eddie Murphy, Clark Duke, Cliff Curtis Jack McCall on libekeelne kirjandustoimetaja, kes on oma tahtmise saamiseks võimeline ütlema mida iganes. Kuid peagi tuleb ka tal ette hetk, mil ta oleks pidanud oma sõnadega ettevaatlikum olema, kuna pärast alusetu lubaduse andmist vaimse guru Sinjale muutub tema elu peatselt väga keeruliseks. Nimelt Jacki tagaaeda kasvab üleöö üks maagiline puu, mis iga Jacki poetatud sõna peale langetab ühe lehe ja iga langenud lehte võib arvestada kui sammu lähemale Jacki surmale.

programme.title: Preeriakodu kaaslane
programme.desc: Legendaarse USA režissööri Robert Altmani viimaseks jäänud linateos viib vaataja filmile nime andnud raadiosaate viimase salvestuse telgitagustesse. Stuudiosse kogunenud raadiotöötajad ja muusikud (Meryl Streep, Woody Harrelson, Tommy-Lee Jones jpt) üritavad aastakümneid eetris olnud kantrisaadet nukra meeleolu kiuste väärikalt ära saata. Seda kuni saatusliku hetkeni, mil lugu võtab üleloomuliku pöörde...

programme.title: Kuu parim töötaja
programme.desc: Kastitassija Zack Bradley ja kassapidaja Vince Downey on kaks supermarketi rivaalitsevat töötajat. Vince on saanud peakassiiriks ning valiti 17 korda järjest kuu parimaks töötajaks. Zack on igavene lohe, aga oma kollegide hulgas hinnatud mees. Kui tööle saabub uus kassapidaja, silmipimestavalt kaunis ja seksikas Amy, muutub poes kõik. Zack ja Vince hakkavad võyitlema Amy tähelepanu nimel. Vince võlub naist oma kassapidamisoskuste ja auhindadega, Zack püüab võita Amy poolehoidu oma sarmi ja naljadega.

programme.title: Emoji film
programme.desc: "Emoji film" paljastab meie nutitelefonides peituva salamaailma. Sõnumirakendustes on peidus Textopolis, kihav linn, kus elavad kõik su lemmik-emojid. Selles maailmas on kõikidel emojidel ainult üks nägu - kõigil peale Gene'i, elaval ja püsimatul mitme näoga emojil. Gene soovib olla normaalne nagu kõik teised ning selleks palub ta abi oma parimalt sõbralt Hi-5'lt ja koodimurdjalt Jailbreakilt. Koos asuvad nad eepilisele äpiseiklusele läbi paljude rakendustele, millest igaühes peitub metsik ja lõbus maailm. Kõikide emojide saatus sõltub kolmest sõbrast, kes peavad päästma oma maailma, enne kui see igaveseks kustutatakse.

programme.title: Tema see ongi
programme.desc: Komöödia kooli kõige kuumemast kutist Zackist, kelle tüdruk ta kuulsa sportlase pärast maha jätab. Kibestunud Zack veab oma sõbraga kihla, et kättemaksuks ta teeb kooli kõige inetumast ja veidramast tüdrukust Laney'st uue kuuma sekspommi. Kuid eneselegi ootamatult armub ta kõigi poolt põlatud neiusse ning populaarsus ei oma siin enam mingit tähtsust…

programme.title: Suhete mänguväljak
programme.desc: Jalgpallurist südametemurdja satub saatuse tahtel laste jalgpallimeeskonna treeneriks. Sellest hetkest muutub jalgpalliplats tema hoolealuste ja nende veetlevate emade suhete mänguväljakuks.

programme.title: Billi ja Tedi suurepärane seiklus
programme.desc: Kaks koolivenda unistavad muusikukarjäärist. Neil on oma bänd ja nad pühendavad kogu vaba aja rock'n'rollile. Aga kui nad ei esita ajaloo ettekannet, on muusikaga lõpp.

programme.title: Rocky ja Bullwinkle'i seiklused
programme.desc: Kurjad spioonid Boris Badenov ja Natasha Fatale ühendavad jõud Kartmatu Liidriga, et vallutada kogu maailm. Orav Rocky ja põder Bullwinkle on kurjamite peatammise nimel kõigeks valmis.

programme.title: Ja nii ma abiellusin kirvemõrvariga
programme.desc: Suhtefoobikust San Francisco poeet leiab lõpuks oma äravalitu, kuid siis hakkab ta uskuma, et naine on kirvega sarimõrvar.

programme.title: Rokkiv paat
programme.desc: 1966. aastal, Briti popmuusika kuldajal, täidab piraatraadiojaam Radio Rock eetri ööpäevaringselt popi ja rokiga, köites miljoneid kuulajaid. Pardal tegutsevad värvikad DJ-d, kelle metsik populaarsus ajab marru ministri, kes kuulutab neile sõja.

programme.title: Kuum pirukas: Klassikokkutulek
programme.desc: USA 2012 komöödia Lavastaja: Jon Hurwitz Osades: Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan, Chris Klein, Thomas Jan Nicholas, Tara Reid Kõik filmi "Kuum pirkukas" staarid naasevad gümnaasiumi kokkutulekule. Pika nädalavahetuse jooksul avastavad nad, kes on muutunud ja kes mitte, ning selgub, et aeg ja suured vahemaad ei suuda lõhkuda sõprussidemeid. See oli 1999. aasta kevadel, kui neli väikelinna Michigani poissi võtsid ette missiooni kaotamaks oma süütust. Nüüd on need eluaegsed sõbrad naasnud täiskasvanutena koju, et meenutada möödunud aegu.

programme.title: Wayne'i maailm
programme.desc: Film põhineb saate Saturday Night Live samanimelisel sketšil. Napakas ja kõiki piire kompavas popkultuuri-komöödias järgitakse armsalt sihitute heavy-meeste Wayne'i ja Garthi seiklusi.

programme.title: Minu väike poni: Sõprus on imeline
programme.desc: Ponid elavad suures sõpruses ja aitavad üksteisel ning ka teistel külaelanikel raskustest üle saada.

programme.title: Hoodie
programme.desc: "Hoodie" on superkangelase lugu täiesti tavalisest poisist, kellel on erakordne parkuuri talent ja õiglustunne. Nüüd on ta juba kaks aastat harjutanud parkuurimist Soufianiga, Brüsseli parima jäljekütiga. Ta teeb seda salaja, sest tema ema, innukas politseinik, ei kiidaks seda iial heaks. Kui kolm naabruskonna last Flo, Basim ja Kenza avastavad Pieteri talendi ja motivatsiooni, ühinevad nad ootamatuks superkangelaste tiimiks nimega tiim Hoodie. Neid ühendab üks eesmärk - vabastada naabruskond ülekohtust.
